messages:
Maya R.: Heads-up: final upload weekend for the performance cycle. Manager edits deadline is Mon 2025-06-02 17:00 UTC. We27ll do a phased Workday ingest Tue 2025-06-03 08:00 UTC. If you need manual assistance, claim a 30m handoff slot.

Ethan S.: Quick note on forms: please use "Manager Review Form v4" (the new one normalizes competency names). Do NOT copy older exports into it, it breaks the upload.

Nina K.: Where do managers mark parental leave / extended LOA?

Maya R.: Put LOA in the header field "payroll_exceptions" with LOA_TYPE and start/end dates. Example: payroll_exceptions=LOA_PAREN_2025-05-12:2025-08-12. That flags the record to be excluded from calibration by default.

Carlos V.: Contractors update: contractor reviews go into the same form but add "contractor:true" in header and include final day. We won27t batch them unless you explicitly request it.

Ethan S.: For cross-functional reviewers: please confirm reviewer name matches People Ops directory (case-sensitive). Mismatches cause mapping errors in the batch.

Maya R.: Calibration sessions: Wed 2025-06-03 at 13:00 UTC and 19:00 UTC (60m). Sign-up: https://go/redwood/cal-2025. If you have >8 reports, ask for a private panel slot.

Nina K.: Can managers submit later if they27re waiting on peer feedback?

Maya R.: Late edits after the ingest will be manually processed but only for urgent exceptions (LOA, termination, new hire correction). Non-urgent late changes will be deferred to the next cycle.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Mon 2025-06-02 17:00 UTC" posted 2025-05-30 09:00 UTC. Reaction: :bell:

Carlos V.: If you hit an import error on Tue morning, DM me a screenshot and the csv slice. I27ll run a small-batch import to minimize disruption.

Ethan S.: Tiny template you can paste to ping managers:

```
Subject: Action required 27Manager edits due Mon 17:00 UTC27
Hi folks,
Please finalize Manager Review Form v4 by Mon 17:00 UTC. Attach evidence for any ratings below expectations and add LOA tags in the header. We27ll ingest Tue 08:00 UTC. Contact #people-ops if you need a handoff slot.
Thanks,
People Ops
```

Maya R.: Final checklist I27ll post tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone for coordinating. :pray:
